notes: MG1655 in M9 glucose (MG_glc) and with glutamate (supplement, control) are controls; no-trace-element MG1655 = metal_limitation. BW25113 KOs have no BW25113 WT in the series. Design says glutamine, protocol says 10 mM glutamate; amino_acids_supplied left out for those two. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655 samples are wild_type.
